elements.element: Services are warranted to be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: Inserted: "(2) for thirty (30) days following performance, the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner."

elements.element: Deliverables or software are warranted to conform to their documentation.
elements.evidence: Inserted: "the Site and any software provided by HDI hereunder will conform in all material respects to its documentation."

elements.element: The software conformance warranty lasts 12 months.
elements.evidence: Inserted period is "ninety (90) days following delivery" for software, not twelve months.
Inserted Services period is "thirty (30) days following performance", short of 90 days.

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: "HDI shall, at the Company's request, repair or replace the non-conforming software or Services..."
"...or refund the amounts paid for them."

elements.element: Vendor warrants compliance with applicable laws.
elements.evidence: No compliance-with-laws warranty appears in Section 9 as rendered; the insertion is limited to conformance and workmanlike performance.

elements.element: Vendor warrants that the Services and Deliverables contain no malicious code.
elements.evidence: No malicious-code warranty in the inserted or retained Section 9 language.

elements.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: "for ninety (90) days following delivery, the Site and any software provided by HDI hereunder will conform in all material respects to its documentation" — express software-to-documentation warranty at exactly 90 days.

elements.element: Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
elements.evidence: "for thirty (30) days following performance, the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner" — 30-day Services warranty.

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: "repair or replace the non-conforming software or Services".
"or refund the amounts paid for them".

reasons: Fallback checklist is complete: express 90-day software/Site conformance-to-documentation warranty, 30-day Services warranty, and a repair/replace-or-refund remedy, all in operative language rather than promised in the comment.

Preferred level is incomplete on four elements (12-month software period, 90-day Services period, compliance with applicable laws, no malicious code); the finding correctly targets the fallback, so this is a compliant fallback-level proposal against a document that previously had no express performance warranty.

Minimality holds: the insertion is a concise new sentence pair into an existing but non-substantive "Warranties" section, no existing (including Customer-favourable) language is deleted or paraphrased, and no survival tail, at-own-expense wording, extra damages categories or procedural boilerplate is added.

Two drafting deltas from model language are noted but not fatal because the elements do not fix them: the remedy elects "at the Company's request" rather than at Vendor's option (Customer-favourable, within the remedy element), and "amounts paid" is broader than "fees paid" (also Customer-favourable, and the element only requires a refund).

Actionable follow-up (not a defect in the mapped elements): confirm "Services" is a defined term elsewhere in the Agreement — the resolved definitions show only HDI, Company and Deerskin Products, and Section 1 is captioned "HDI's Responsibilities". If "Services" is not defined, replace it with a reference to the services/responsibilities described in Sections 1.1–1.8 to avoid a dangling term.

No disclaimer exists to swallow the new express warranty, so no carve-out sentence was needed and its absence is not a gap; retained Section 9(a) corporate-authority representations and 9(b) Globix acknowledgment are untouched and not contradicted.
